  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION

  SUBJECT: CHM 1071-CHM/CHM 1071-B/CHM 1051-B - ENGINEERING CHEMISTRY  
  (MAKEUP)  
  ENGINEERING CHEMISTRY [CHM 1071-CHM]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1A)          Explain why glass electrode cannot be used to measure pH below 2 and above 10. A  
  glass electrode dipped in a solution of pH = 4 offered an emf of 0.2066 V with  
  decinormal calomel electrode (0.2412 V) at 298 K. When dipped in a solution of      (4)  
  unknown pH at the same temperature, the recorded emf was 0.1076 V. Calculate the pH  
  of the soln.  
  
  1B)          Write two differences between the following;  
  i) Concentration and kinetic polarization  
  ii) Electroplating and electroless plating                                                  (4)  
  iii) Fuel and galvanic cells  
  iv) Primary and secondary batteries  
  
  1C)          Write the cell reaction and calculate the emf in volts for the following cell  
  Fe(s) | Fe2+(0.1 M) || Cd2+(0.2 M) | Cd at 298 K.                                           (2)  
  
  2A)          i) Explain the conductometric titration of strong acid against a weak base with necessary  
  reaction and graph.  
  ii) The absorbance of a copper sulphate solution containing 0.500 mg cupric ions/mL  
  was found to be 0.3500 at 440 nm. i) Calculate the specific absorptivity of copper          (4)  
  sulphate if the thickness of the cuvette is 1.00 cm. ii) What will be the absorbance if the  
  solution is diluted to twice its original volume?  
  
  2B)          i) Explain any two reasons for the formation of scales in boilers.  
  ii) Explain phosphate conditioning and carbonate conditioning for the prevention of         (4)  
  scaling.  
  
  2C)          Give the advantages and disadvantages of lime soda process which is used for softening  
  the hard water.                                                                        (2)  
  
  3A)          Write any two differences between the following:  
  i) Galvanizing and Tinning.  
  ii) Cathodic and Anodic inhibitors.                                                         (4)  
  iii) Electrochemical and Galvanic series.  
  iv) Dry and Wet corrosion.
